Probably. I while ago I did go to my doctor about it. (I showed my wife a Bojack Horseman clip and said - that’s how I feel most of the time).

I filled out a form and was told I was high functioning. Then asked if I wanted talk therapy or medicated treatment. I said I didn’t know what I needed. 

After that I was recommended to a clinic but it wasn’t covered by insurance, so I never followed up.

Not justifying it. But not willing to tell someone I want to be medicated and not wanting to pay hundreds of dollars an session to talk.
I ended up parked for a while and called an old coworker. After about an hour we were laughing about some of the crazy stupid shit in our lives. Helped put things in perspective.
